comments.author: Lastingfordays
comments.body_html:
I am having troubles getting custom midi files to play. I downloaded a midi file from https://midifind.com and put it into TarkovMIDI > Midi-Songs. Will it play at random or is there a way to play it specifically?

Thank you in advanced!

comments.author: privateryan
comments.body_html:
Before you load into the raid, in TarkovMIDI’s settings through F12 (Configuration Manager), enable the following settings

  • Enable MIDI
  • Auto Connect

If you want to use the MIDI functionality, and even if you don’t have a MIDI device, you need to enable these settings. Otherwise, it will default to the built-in songs.

Once MIDI is enabled, just hit the P key, or whatever you have binded in TarkovMIDI’s settings.

But here I have one question: Can I add other custom sound files to this mod? Cause when I convert my origin sound files into midi files, it will lose a lot of details:(

comments.author: privateryan
comments.body_html: No you can’t. That’s just what happens when you convert a song to MIDI and leave it as is. You could either edit them to get your desired result, or download a MIDI file made by someone else, which usually works pretty well. When you search for the song MIDI file, I recommend you look for Piano/Guitar versions.
